points.text: M1: Any two of amide, amine and carboxylic acid correctly identified

M1: peptide / amide bond / unit labelled or circled in dipeptide structure containing $\text{H}_2\text{N}-\text{C}(\text{C}_3\text{H}_7)(\text{H})-\text{C}(=\text{O})-\text{N}(\text{H})-\text{C}(\text{CH}_2\text{CONH}_2)(\text{H})-\text{CO}_2\text{H}$ or the val-asp / asp-val reverse order isomer
M2: (val-asp or asp-val) rest of the dipeptide structure is correct
M1: resists change in pH / pH kept within a small range
M2: when small amount of acid or alkali / base is added
M1: first enantiomer 3D structure as shown with $\text{COOH}$, central $\text{C}$ bonded to R, H and $\text{NH}_2$ in correct tetrahedral mirror-image arrangement
